$comment: Geometry recipes (pipeline/transit_pipeline/past.py): the Santa Rosa and Petaluma horsecar lines on today's street centerlines.

sr-hc-fourth-st.note: East along Fourth St from the San Francisco & North Pacific depot at Wilson St to McDonald Ave (Borden), across today's freeway and mall, where Overture has no 4th St; the same street as the Petaluma & Santa Rosa's later track

sr-hc-mcdonald-ave.note: North on McDonald Ave from Fourth St to the Rural Cemetery's south corner (Borden), where today's Franklin Ave begins; the 1916 and 1954 sheets draw the street to the corner

pet-hc-f-st-washington-st.note: From the car barn at 12th and F Sts by F St, 6th St, Liberty St, Western Ave, Kentucky St and Washington St, across Petaluma Creek and the San Francisco & North Pacific, to Payran St (Borden, from a map of 1897). Not drawn: the last stretch to just beyond Mary St, and the branch into the fairgrounds, since no Mary St crosses Washington St today
